lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in at least four visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary spot clusters, forming high-intensity nodes within a faint rectangular lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from light upper margins to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface exhibits a high-density distribution of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance points distinct from the larger grid-patterned spots on the flank.
